jobs.description:
About the Team
OpenAI and its capital and technology partners are building a global network of data centers for demanding AI workloads. The Infrastructure Quality team sets and verifies quality, reliability, and performance requirements for equipment across that network.
We work with manufacturing partners, general contractors, engineers, and operations staff from supplier qualification through commissioning. Together, we verify that equipment arrives ready for installation, startup, and long-term service.
About the Role
As a Manufacturing Quality Engineer, you will oversee the quality of data center equipment at supplier factories. You will use production data, audits, and test results to identify systemic, recurring, or safety-related issues and work with suppliers to address them through Closed Loop Learning (CLL).
You will work with suppliers and internal teams to define inspections and factory tests for each type of equipment. You will coordinate issue resolution before shipment and manage deviations across multiple suppliers and project sites.
Key Responsibilities
Manufacturing Monitoring and Supplier Improvement
• Manufacturing monitoring: Work with Manufacturing Operations to monitor production progress, quality controls, inspection results, and test readiness. Flag emerging risks and coordinate a response with suppliers.

• Product and process audits: Audit products and processes during and after production against engineering requirements, critical-to-quality (CTQ) characteristics, approved procedures, and quality standards. Document findings and track corrective actions to closure.

• Manufacturing coordination: Agree on production checkpoints and inspection and testing requirements with suppliers, engineering, sourcing, supply chain, commissioning, and quality teams. Escalate risks to equipment acceptance or delivery.

• Manufacturing scorecards: Develop supplier and product scorecards with Manufacturing Operations. Review audit findings, test results, recurring defects, and open issues with suppliers to prioritize improvements.

• Drive continuous improvement: Lead the CLL process with suppliers. Track root cause analyses and corrective and preventive actions in a shared register. Verify that each action addresses the underlying problem before closing it.

Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT)
• Standardize requirements and formats: Develop product-specific FAT requirements and standard test formats with equipment suppliers and OpenAI’s engineering, commissioning, quality, and Manufacturing Operations teams.

• Define critical quality requirements: Document the CTQ characteristics each test must verify in an OpenAI-accepted format. Use CLL findings to revise FAT procedures so future tests check for known failure modes.

• Ensure auditable supplier records: Require suppliers to retain test results and make them available for OpenAI audits.

• Manage documentation and revision control: Review final FAT records and audit reports for each piece of equipment and maintain a controlled revision history.

• Conduct periodic supplier audits: Check that suppliers follow approved test procedures and that their records accurately reflect the tests performed.

Factory Witness Testing (FWT)
• Align checklists and stakeholders: Develop standard FWT checklists with OpenAI subject matter experts, installing contractors, and the construction management team. Agree on requirements before testing begins.

• Manage documentation and reporting: Collect and review final witness test reports and supporting records from participants.

• Before shipment, confirm that each witness-test issue is resolved or covered by a documented deviation. Log systemic, recurring, or safety-related findings in the CLL tracker and verify the effectiveness of corrective actions with the supplier.

Deviation Management
• Assess short shipments and missing or failed tests in partnership with Manufacturing Operations.

• Coordinate supplier support to resolve issues at the project site.

• Document each deviation and track the agreed actions through closure.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical, or industrial engineering.

• At least 10 years of data center industry experience spanning quality engineering and project management.

• Experience coordinating FAT and FWT with suppliers and resolving equipment quality issues.

• Ability to develop test checklists, define CTQs, review test results, and maintain auditable quality records.

• Experience monitoring supplier production, auditing products and processes during and after production, and using scorecards to improve supplier and product quality. Experience managing controlled documents and deviations.

• Ability to coordinate supplier schedules and plan inspections and tests across multiple pieces of equipment.

• Ability to communicate quality requirements and coordinate decisions across suppliers, engineering, commissioning, sourcing, supply chain, manufacturing, operations, quality, and construction teams.

• Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40–60% of the time to supplier manufacturing facilities and data center project sites.

Preferred Skills
• Technical knowledge of data center infrastructure, including mechanical, electrical, and controls systems.

• Experience in supplier performance management for mission-critical facilities.

• ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, Quality Manager, or Quality Auditor.

• PMP or equivalent project management certification.

• Experience in industrial or high-volume manufacturing environments.

About OpenAI
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Staff AI Engineer to join our Information Technology Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Engineering team, reporting directly to the Senior Manager, AI Engineering, based out of our Santa Clara, CA office on a 3-day hybrid schedule. In this hands-on leadership role, you will serve as the technical lead across two high-impact organizations—the AI Platform group and the AI Solutions and Support group—defining architectural vision, establishing core enterprise infrastructure, such as model gateways and context management, and driving production-grade AI applications and operational workflows across global teams.

What you'll do

• Architect and scale enterprise AI platform capabilities, including model gateways, intelligent routing, cost governance, LLM observability, evaluation pipelines, and long-term agent memory

• Direct technical execution for AI solutions and support, spearheading enterprise AI platform administration, intelligent search experiences, and scalable L2 operational support frameworks

• Lead distributed engineering teams across the US and India, aligning roadmap priorities, conducting technical reviews, and fostering seamless communication across time zones

• Establish engineering excellence and production AI quality gates, overseeing hands-on code development, CI/CD pipelines, regression suites, and latency and cost optimization

• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders in Security, Legal, Privacy, and enterprise business units to ensure compliant, secure, and impactful AI enablement

Who You Are

• You are a seasoned technical leader who thrives at the intersection of enterprise architecture, distributed team leadership, and hands-on software engineering.

• You possess deep technical breadth in architecting production-grade LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation systems, and comprehensive AI evaluation frameworks.

• You are an operational driver with a proven track record of reducing systemic friction, resolving production incidents, and automating support processes.

• You excel at bridging time zones and cultures, empowering both internal engineers and external partners through empathetic mentorship and clear technical guidance.

• You are an articulate communicator and collaborative partner who seamlessly aligns technical strategy with executive stakeholders across business, security, and governance functions.

What We're Looking for

• Demonstrated hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade AI/LLM applications, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agents, function calling/MCP, and model evaluation or observability frameworks

• 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

• 3+ years of technical leadership experience guiding distributed engineering teams and external contractors across multiple time zones

• Proficiency in full-stack development utilizing Python, TypeScript/Node.js (or Java/Go), modern front-end frameworks like React, and robust API design

• Hands-on expertise in cloud and containerized infrastructure, including AWS (or GCP/Azure), Docker, Kubernetes, and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines

• Proven background operating production enterprise services, including incident response, on-call management, runbook development, and SLA governance

What Will Make You Stand Out

• Advanced expertise administering enterprise AI platforms (such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Amazon Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI) with comprehensive cost governance, security controls, and usage optimization

• Experience architecting vector and graph database solutions, semantic caching, and dynamic long-term agent memory management

• Proven success deploying intelligent conversational bots, search experiences, and Slack integrations within enterprise workflows, alongside familiarity with model fine-tuning, open-weight model serving, or compliance standards in regulated environments such as FedRAMP

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

The Access Management team owns the core systems that determine what users, applications, and automated workloads can do across the Databricks platform. You will evolve the platform's authorization service, consolidate permission checking under a unified authorization model, and build fine-grained controls including scoped service identities, delegated access, role-based access control, and network ingress policies—all while improving the availability and reliability of a high-throughput, low-latency service.

The Impact You Will Have

• Design, build, and operate scalable authorization systems that enforce access control across the Databricks platform

• Own complex technical projects end-to-end, from design through delivery and production operation

• Drive technical decisions and contribute to architectural direction for access management infrastructure

• Improve system reliability, performance, and security for high-throughput, low-latency services

• Collaborate with teams across engineering and product to deliver unified authorization capabilities

• Mentor engineers and elevate team engineering practices

• 5+ years of software engineering experience

• Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems in production environments

• Experience with one or more programming languages including Java, Scala, C++, or Go

• Understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including concurrency, microservices architecture, and cloud infrastructure

• Experience with authorization systems, identity management, or security-focused infrastructure

• Ability to diagnose performance bottlenecks and execute root-cause analyses for production issues

• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across teams

• B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We're hiring Cyber Evaluations Engineers to build and run the evaluations that measure cyber-relevant capabilities and safeguard robustness in our models. You'll design new evals, run per-release robustness testing, and dig into data on jailbreaks and prompt bypasses to understand where our safeguards hold up and where they don't. You'll also design many of the probes that detect cyber abuse in production and help shape the overall detection architecture alongside the policy team.

Key responsibilities

•
Design and run capability, uplift, and safety evaluations to assess cyber-relevant risk in new models

•
Execute per-release safeguard-robustness testing ahead of major model launches

•
Analyze evaluation results and communicate findings clearly to the team and to stakeholders

•
Design, prototype, and tune detection probes for cyber misuse

•
Work with the cyber policy team to turn policy lines into a layered, robust abuse-detection architecture, and measure its precision and coverage over time

•
Build and maintain internal tooling used to run and score evaluations

•
Collaborate with policy and engineering partners to translate eval findings into safeguard improvements

Minimum qualifications

•
Experience building or running evaluations, benchmarks, or test suites for software or ML systems, including delivering results on short, fixed timelines

•
Hands-on cybersecurity experience (e.g., CTF participation, vulnerability research, exploit development, or security research)

•
Proficiency in Python

•
Strong ability to communicate evaluation results with multiple cross-functional stakeholders or potential policy stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

•
Deep offensive-security or security-research experience, including experience building AI security benchmarks

•
Experience analyzing adversarial or abuse data (e.g., jailbreaks, prompt bypasses, intrusion or fraud telemetry)

•
Experience working onsite with government partners on testing or evaluation engagements

•
Experience with AI/ML evaluation frameworks

•
Familiarity with coordinated vulnerability disclosure practices

•
Experience testing pre-release or pre-deployment software or models under confidentiality constraints

•
Experience authoring detection content (e.g., Sigma, YARA, Suricata, SIEM rules) or building ML-based abuse detection

•
Active secret security clearance or higher, or eligibility to obtain one

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$300,000 — $405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role
As a Risk Strategy Intern at Ramp, you’ll use data, analytics, and AI to help develop strategies that protect Ramp and our customers while enabling business growth.
You’ll have the opportunity to join our Fraud Strategy, Onboarding Risk, or Portfolio Risk teams, gaining hands-on experience solving real business problems. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional partners, analyze data, and help build scalable solutions that improve how Ramp manages risk.
This is a 12-week summer internship based in New York City.

What You’ll Do
• Analyze data to identify trends, uncover insights, and recommend improvements to risk strategies

• Use SQL and AI tools to investigate business problems and support data-driven decision-making

• Help develop and optimize risk policies across fraud prevention, customer onboarding, and portfolio management

• Partner with cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, and Data Science, to implement solutions

• Research emerging risk trends and explore opportunities to improve processes through AI and automation

• Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders

What You Need
• Currently pursuing a B.S. or higher in Computer Science or a related technical field, graduating December 2027 or later, with coursework or project experience in data science, business analytics, machine learning, or AI.

• Experience with SQL for data analysis and querying

• Hands-on experience using AI/LLMs to solve problems through coursework, internships, or personal projects

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in using data to solve business challenges

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Curiosity, willingness to learn, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

Nice to Haves
• Experience with Python or other data analysis tools

• Previous internship or project experience involving data analysis, modeling, or business strategy

• Interest in fintech, fraud prevention, or credit risk management

jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Options Web team builds the web experiences that let customers trade options on Robinhood. The team works across Robinhood.com and Legend, our web trading platform for active traders. Its work covers trading flows, options onboarding for new customers, and monitoring tools. On Legend, the team builds the options pieces, including options details in the positions widget and the Option Chain tool. You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and the mobile options team, and you'll see your work reach customers fast!

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person hybrid attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

• Act as tech lead for options on web, setting direction on platform topics such as performance and observability

• Design, build, test, and roll out features in React and TypeScript across trading flows, options onboarding, and monitoring tools

• Own projects end to end, from options team projects to large efforts that involve cross-team collaboration.

• Break larger projects into smaller pieces and guide other engineers as they build them

• Diagnose complex performance problems and data issues, including options calculations, find the root cause, and set up monitoring to catch problems early

• Partner with product managers and designers (and content designers when needed) to shape and ship customer-facing features

• Work with the mobile options team so options features feel consistent across platforms

What you bring

• 7+ years of professional software development experience.

• Strong web engineering fundamentals, with hands-on experience building production web applications in React and TypeScript

• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with a record of finding root causes in performance and data problems

• Experience owning projects end to end, from design through development, testing, and rollout

• Experience leading projects and setting technical direction, such as improving performance or observability

• Clear communication about technical tradeoffs with engineers, product managers, and designers

• Nice to have: familiarity with options trading or other fintech and trading products (no options experience is required, and we'll teach you the domain)

• Nice to have: prior tech lead experience, including at smaller companies

What we offer

• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career

• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching

• Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents

• Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.

• Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.

• Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more

• Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits

• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Base Pay Range:

Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)
$196,000 — $230,000 USD

Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL)
$172,000 — $202,000 USD

Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL)
$153,000 — $179,000 USD

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

Application Limit: Candidates may submit no more than 3 applications in any 90 days. Within that time, they may apply to each role only once.

Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.
